source_backed_contracts.behavior_contract: Validated episode text/type/source timestamp/metadata; source provenance survives SDK projection.
Exactly one graph_id or user_id; no silent destination fallback.
Omit unset optional fields; forwards to managed Zep graph API, not local persistence.
Absent timestamp allowed; supplied value must parse and have an explicit timezone.
Named fact endpoints, optional UUID identities, source-validity timestamps and metadata; SDK owns fact creation.
Unsent transport failures/429 retried; ambiguous writes/5xx require explicit idempotency permission.
Seconds or aware HTTP date; nonfinite/unparseable delays unavailable; elapsed delays zero.
Preview runs loader/transforms without SDK writes; run validates replay then uses selected submitter. Whole orchestration replacement not claimed.
Explicit alias rewrite/annotation with ambiguity/risky-word guards; must never silently establish commerce identity.
